content.title: Did 34 YO Sykkuno Date Underage VTubers? His Ex-GF, HemomalVT Clarifies, 'Confused Predator...'
content.text: Popular VTube streamer, Sykkuno, known for his shy, 'wholesome' persona, has found himself in a massive controversy. In April 2026, his ex-girlfriend, HemomalVT, came forward to expose him on behalf of all the small female creators he had led on while in a live-in relationship with his real girlfriend. HemomalVT's bombshell accusations were included in a 32-page Google doc, including several DM screenshots and a call recording. She labelled him as a "predator", which led to concerns regarding him dating underage girls. Amid the buzz, Hemomal herself clarified the rumours. What were HemomalVT's allegations against Sykkuno? VTuber, Hemomal claimed that Sykkuno specifically targeted "smaller or up-and-coming content creators," using his fame and financial power to influence them. Her document alleges that he used his status and "soft-spoken" persona to manipulate women, often providing "emotional intimacy" and discussing long-term plans such as moving in together. As she saw it, it was his way of leading the women on, "knowing that he can take advantage of them." The document's contents included: "He is a serial cheater, liar, and manipulator who uses his status to get what he wants from as many women as possible, more specifically, ones who are smaller or up-and-coming content creators, knowing that he can take advantage of them." Hemomal further claimed that Sykkuno used his financial influence to toy with the feelings of those women. She alleged a sugar daddy-like pattern of behaviour, where Sykkuno would allegedly send hundreds of dollars or pay for expensive trips to places like Paris for the women he was pursuing. She described him as a "predator," alleging that he used his fame and money to lure women like her and fellow creator, Elfilea. She also shared DM screenshots, payment receipts, and voice notes as evidence of his planning hook-ups at every event he attended, while leading others to believe he wanted a long-term commitment. Did Sykkuno date minors? HemomalVT clarifies her "predator" comment Hemomal's usage of the term "predator" for Sykkuno sparked online chatter regarding him having a predatory behaviour towards underage girls. Notably, the 34-year-old Sykkuno has been romantically involved with women almost half his age, including 18 and 19-year-olds. This information backed the speculation that he might have dated even younger girls. However, according to Hemomal, that wasn't the case. She clarified on X (formerly Twitter) that her ex-fling never dated any minor. Thus, the term "predator" was intended to describe Sykkuno's pattern of emotional manipulation rather than illegal conduct with minors. Her exact words were: "For everyone confused predator isn't pedo. He preys on small female vtubers and lies to them and gives them half truths with the intention to have sexual interactions with them. English isn't my first language so I thought I'd clear that up!" More about HemomalVT HemomalVT is a VTuber and content creator based in Europe who gained significant online attention in April 2026 due to her major allegations against popular creator, Sykkuno in the same field. HemomalVT is recognised as a budding content creator and VTuber within the gaming and streaming community. According to Poprant, she presents herself as an "unlicensed nurse bunny." She created and maintained the online persona through her cute and chaotic aesthetic, mixed with darker themes. Continue reading below As a niche content creator, HemomalVT typically maintains a relatively small audience, with roughly 11,000 followers on X (formerly Twitter) and a modest presence on Twitch. HemomalVT's content is centred around art, gaming and frequent interactive sessions with her community. The VTuber often showcases digital illustration or character design or engages in gaming streaming. Despite her status as a non-mainstream creator, Hemomal became the subject of widespread discussion following her public accusations against Sykkuno regarding cheating on multiple female creators.
